[[File:Ellen.png|thumb|250px|Ellen]]
(Japanese: '''エレン''' ''Ellen'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP139|Mild 'n Wooly]]''.

Ellen is {{OBP|Mary|EP139}}'s mother, who lives with her on a {{p|Mareep}} ranch in a valley between [[Violet City]] and [[Azalea Town]]. When {{Ash}}, {{an|Misty}}, and {{an|Brock}} came to visit, they were preparing for the annual [[Mareep Festival]]. 

She originally seemed quite strict, scolding her daughter for letting the Mareep escape, and even scaring [[Ash's Pikachu]]. She would not let Mary compete in the festival, saying she was too young and careless of Fluffy's condition to enter. However, after seeing Mary's battle abilities and strategies against {{TRT}}, she changed her mind. The next morning, she presented her daughter with her old {{i|Poké Ball}} and gave her permission to compete.
{{-}}
